outcome: Complications (HTN, DM, preterm labor, or short cervix)
cohort: 334 pregnant patients with opioid use disorder treated with buprenorphine
finding: The NOWS rate in the buprenorphine weaned cohort was significantly lower than the controls with no observed increase in maternal or neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not significantly differ between the buprenorphine wean and control groups.
